hero.tagline: Using Machine Learning and Palantir AIP to Revolutionize wildfire spread prediction

steps.heading: Step 1: Data Collection
steps.body: We gathered current and historical wildfire and conditions data from various sources such as NASA FIRMS and Open Meteo. We collected factors such as humidity, temperature, dryness, and biomass. We then used Palantir's tools to clean and transform the data.

steps.heading: Step 2: Training
steps.body: We then used the cleaned data to train a model in Palantir which would take in current data inputs such as humidity, temperature, dryness, and biomass and outputs a predicted fire radius.

steps.heading: Step 3: Exposing Function
steps.body: We then converted the model into a typescript function. Then we exposed the function to be called through javascript.

steps.heading: Step 4: FrontEnd
steps.body: We built a front end in HTML which displays a map and animates how the fire will spread depending on a location.

steps.heading: Future Plans
steps.body: We plan to expand our model and train it with more data to make a more accurate prediction.
